senses.gloss:
--R. from the Sahya hill, the northern part of the Sahya where the गोदावरि is a charming spot. Here was founded the town Govardhana, and was planted flower trees by भरद्वाज.
1: भा. V. १९. १८; Br. I. १२. १५; II. १६. ३४-45; वा. ४५. १०४, ११२. Vi. II. 3. १२.
R. sacred to पितृस्, filled with Lingas; also जामदग्नीतीर्थम्; personified as a wife of हव्यवा- hana fire.
2: M. २२. ४६ and ५७-8; ५१. १३; ११४. २९; १६३. ६१. वा. २९. १३.
--banks of गोदावरी, whence sages visited द्वारक. भा. X. ९०. २८ [5].
--a Janapada of the केतुमाल continent. वा. ४४. १५.
